sleep_diet_correlation.general_principle: Late heavy meals disrupt circadian rhythm → Poor sleep → Next-day metabolic dysregulation
sleep_diet_correlation.physiological_mechanism: Digestive processes compete with sleep neurotransmitter production

timing_rules.breakfast: Within 1 hour of waking - Resets circadian clock
timing_rules.dinner: Before 8:00 PM - Allows 2-3 hour digestion before sleep
timing_rules.late_snack: Only if needed: light, low-glycemic options before 7:00 PM

foods_that_impair_sleep.caffeine: Blocks adenosine receptors - Avoid after 2:00 PM
foods_that_impair_sleep.alcohol: Disrupts REM sleep - Avoid 3+ hours before bed
foods_that_impair_sleep.spicy_foods: Increases body temperature - Avoid 3+ hours before bed
foods_that_impair_sleep.high_fat: Slows digestion - Avoid 3+ hours before bed
foods_that_impair_sleep.high_sugar: Spikes glucose then crashes - Disrupts sleep architecture

foods_that_promote_sleep.tryptophan_rich: Turkey, nuts, seeds - Support serotonin production
foods_that_promote_sleep.magnesium_rich: Spinach, pumpkin seeds, almonds - Relax muscles & calm mind
foods_that_promote_sleep.complex_carbs: Whole grains - Facilitate tryptophan transport to brain
foods_that_promote_sleep.calcium_rich: Low-fat yogurt, fortified plant milk - Supports melatonin synthesis

sleep_quality_impact.poor_sleep_effect: Reduces diet adherence by 40%, increases hunger hormones
sleep_quality_impact.good_sleep_effect: Supports weight loss by 55%, improves metabolic control
sleep_quality_impact.bidirectional_relationship: Good diet → Better sleep → Better diet adherence → Better outcomes

recommended_dinner_composition.whole_grain: ½ cup brown rice or sweet potato
recommended_dinner_composition.fat: 1 teaspoon olive oil or nut butter
recommended_dinner_composition.avoid: Added sodium, processed ingredients, high sugar

circadian_nutrition.concept: Align eating with biological clock for optimal metabolism
circadian_nutrition.breakfast: Largest meal when insulin sensitivity highest

sleep_improvement_tracking.baseline_measurement: Record sleep quality for 1 week before diet change
sleep_improvement_tracking.weekly_assessment: Track sleep hours & quality every 7 days
sleep_improvement_tracking.expected_improvement: 40% report better sleep within 2-3 weeks of diet adherence
metrics: Morning freshness (target: Feel refreshed without stimulants)
